final_message:
Done — all 6 tests pass.

Two bugs, both in recency bookkeeping in `lrucache/cache.py`:

- `get` never called `move_to_end`, so reads didn't refresh recency and recently-used entries got evicted too early (`lrucache/cache.py:31`).
- `put` evicted the LRU entry before checking whether the key already existed, so updating an existing key in a full cache wrongly evicted a different entry (`lrucache/cache.py:34`).

Fixes are one line each; `SOLUTION.md` written as requested. No test files touched, no commits made.
